summary.text: Dan Donahue is a Democratic state representative from the 16th Worcester District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since September 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Cannabis Policy.

paragraphs.text: Dan Donahue holds a bachelor's degree from the College of the Holy Cross, according to his legislative biography.
Before his election he was Director of Policy and Assistant Chief of Staff to Worcester Mayor Joseph M. Petty and political director for Lieutenant Governor Tim Murray.
